create.name: MC YOGI
create.bio:
MC YOGI is a yoga teacher and hip hop artist from the San Francisco Bay Area. As a teenager he was painting graffiti, being thrown out of schools and living in a group home, until his father introduced him to yoga at seventeen. He trained under his father's teacher Larry Schultz, went on to Mysore to practise Ashtanga with Sri K. Pattabhi Jois and Sharath, spent years with the Vedanta Society and later stayed at Ramana Maharshi's ashram at Arunachala. Time among Krishna devotees turned him towards chanting, and he came to regard Neem Karoli Baba as his guru. In 2008 he began recording albums that set mantra and yogic stories over hip hop beats.

His classes are slow, easy-going flows mixed with meditation, mantra, guided relaxation and stories from his own life, drawing on Hindu, Buddhist and Christian sources. He leads residential retreats, including weekends at Kripalu, Drala Mountain Center and the Sivananda ashram in the Bahamas and a week in the Azores, runs an accredited meditation teacher training, and teaches live sessions in his own app. His memoir, Spiritual Graffiti (HarperOne, 2017), tells how yoga redirected his life and won a silver Nautilus Book Award.

books.title: Spiritual Graffiti: Finding My True Path
books.author: MC YOGI
books.description: His memoir, published by HarperOne in 2017. It follows his path from a troubled Bay Area youth spent tagging walls to a life of yoga practice, study in India and making devotional hip hop.

courses.title: The Art of Chilling Out: The Immersive Workshop
courses.description: A four-night stay at Kripalu built around unhurried yoga, longer meditation sittings, guided relaxation and his storytelling. The extra days leave room for journaling, walking meditation and quiet reflection, and all levels are welcome.

courses.title: The Art of Chilling Out: Weekend Edition
courses.description: The two-night version of his Kripalu programme: gentle flowing yoga, meditation and stories from his own path, condensed into a weekend. Suited to beginners and long-time practitioners alike.

courses.title: Divine Yoga, Meditation & Chanting
courses.description: A short programme of evening satsangs and daytime workshops with him at the Sivananda ashram on Paradise Island, Nassau. Guests join the ashram's own daily classes and meals alongside his sessions of yoga, meditation and kirtan.

courses.title: Spiritual Warrior Weekend with MC YOGI: Yoga, Music, & Meditation
courses.description: A weekend at Drala Mountain Center in the Colorado Rockies combining yoga, live music and meditation. Tuition is on a sliding scale and comes with two nights' lodging and meals.
courses.price: $250 to $400 USD with two nights' lodging

courses.title: Azores Islands Yoga & Meditation Retreat
courses.description: Six days on São Miguel in the Azores with morning and evening yoga and meditation, walks to crater lakes, hot springs and coastal paths, and shared meals. Packages are all-inclusive and priced by room type.

courses.title: MC YOGI Meditation & Yoga App
courses.description: His subscription app, with recorded yoga classes, guided meditations, mantra practice, yoga nidra and his music. Twice a month he teaches a live chill yoga and meditation session inside the app, and there is a seven-day free trial.
courses.price: $14.99 USD a month or $150 USD a year

courses.title: Ocean of Awareness
courses.description: A ten-minute guided meditation set to soft music, in which he leads the listener into stillness and a sense of spacious awareness. Sold as a download.

courses.title: Unfolding the Heart
courses.description: A ten-minute musical meditation focused on softening and opening the heart, so that warmth and love can come through more easily. Sold as a download.
